title: Google Local Services Ads Reporting Tool (2026 Guide)

facts.fact: The page states that Google Local Services Ads charge a pay-per-lead fee of $5 to $150 per qualified lead, depending on service category and market competition.
facts.quote: Local Services Ads operate on a pay-per-lead model where you are charged $5–$150 per qualified lead depending on your service category and market competition.

facts.fact: The page cites BrightLocal research finding that 35% of Local Services leads never convert to actual customers.
facts.quote: Research from BrightLocal shows that 35% of Local Services leads never convert to actual customers due to poor qualification, pricing mismatches, or scheduling conflicts.

facts.fact: The page states that contractors without proper tracking spend $2,000–$8,000 monthly on LSA leads that generate zero revenue.
facts.quote: Without proper tracking, contractors spend $2,000–$8,000 monthly on LSA leads that generate zero revenue.

facts.fact: The page is dated April 3, 2026 and was last updated on the same date.
The page's comparison table lists Google My Business Insights as free with a setup time of 5 minutes.
facts.quote: | Google My Business Insights | 5 minutes | Free | Basic lead tracking |

facts.fact: The page's comparison table lists Ryze AI with a free trial and a setup time of 10 minutes.
facts.quote: | Ryze AI | 10 minutes | Free trial | Automated optimization |

facts.fact: The page's comparison table lists CallRail at $30–$150 per month with a setup time of 20 minutes.
The page's comparison table lists Looker Studio as free with a setup time of 45 minutes.
facts.quote: | Looker Studio | 45 minutes | Free | Custom dashboards |

facts.fact: The page's comparison table lists Reporting Ninja at $39–$199 per month with a setup time of 30 minutes.
The page says Ryze AI tracks 18 conversion metrics, including call duration, message response rate, and booking completion percentage (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: It tracks 18 conversion metrics including call duration, message response rate, and booking completion percentage.

facts.fact: The page says Google My Business Insights displays 30-day and 90-day performance windows.
facts.quote: The interface displays 30-day and 90-day performance windows with filters for lead type (calls vs. messages) and service categories.

facts.fact: The page says Reporting Ninja generates weekly and monthly reports in PDF format.
facts.quote: The platform generates weekly and monthly reports in PDF format with white-label branding options for agencies managing multiple clients.
